modules.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
modules.description: Learn the basics of effective prompting

drills.title: Writing Clear Instructions
drills.objective: Learn to write prompts that get consistent results
drills.context: AI models need clear, specific instructions to perform well.
drills.task: Write a prompt that asks AI to extract a person's name and email from unstructured text.
hints: Give an example of expected output
Handle cases where info is missing

solution.prompt:
Extract the person's name and email from the following text. Return the result as JSON with keys 'name' and 'email'. If any field is not found, use null.

Text: {input_text}
solution.explanation: This prompt is clear about what to extract, how to format the output, and how to handle missing data.
